concepts.title: Topics covered
concepts.text_md:
- ELB Types: ALB NLB GLB and Classic Load Balancer
- How Load Balancers Distribute Traffic across targets
- Target Groups & Health Checks — configuration
- SSL/TLS Termination at ELB — certificate management
- Cross-Zone Load Balancing behavior
- High Availability with ELB across multiple AZs

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- ALB is Layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS and routes based on URL path or host header values
- NLB is Layer 4 TCP for ultra-high performance handling millions of requests per second
- Health checks automatically remove unhealthy instances from rotation within seconds
- SSL termination at ELB saves compute resources on EC2 instances for application work
- One ELB can route traffic to EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones
